title: Multi Interests for Joint Search-Recommendation Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2608.10535v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Search and recommendation are crucial for understanding user preferences. More and more studies are attempting to jointly model search behavior and recommendation behavior, by integrating user active search and passive recommendation behavior data to better mine user preferences. However, although existing cross-domain unified modeling frameworks can effectively compensate for the differences in behavior between domains, they overlook the expression of interests in different scenarios under mixed sequences. translated_title: 面向搜索与推荐联合建模的多兴趣方法
translated_abstract: 搜索与推荐对于理解用户偏好至关重要。越来越多的研究尝试对搜索行为与推荐行为进行联合建模，通过整合用户主动搜索与被动推荐的行为数据来更好地挖掘用户偏好。然而，尽管现有的跨域统一建模框架能够有效弥补不同领域之间行为差异，它们却忽视了混合序列中不同场景下兴趣的表达。在本研究中，我们提出了一种基于多兴趣的混合序列建模框架MIJSR，该框架从结构和语义两个视角对搜索推荐混合序列进行多兴趣挖掘与自适应融合。具体而言，我们的模型大致可分为三个模块：跨域行为融合、多兴趣挖掘和多任务预测。首先，我们对…（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出基于多兴趣的混合序列建模框架MIJSR，从结构与语义两个视角对搜索推荐混合序列进行多兴趣挖掘与自适应融合，实现搜索与推荐的联合建模。
en_tdlr: MIJSR is a multi-interest-based mixed sequential modeling framework that jointly models search and recommendation by mining and adaptively integrating multiple interests from both structural and semantic perspectives.
